name: hydroxysteroid 11-beta dehydrogenase 1

function.text: HSD11B1 is the approved symbol for hydroxysteroid 11-beta dehydrogenase 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity; 7-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity; steroid catabolic process.

function.text: HSD11B1 encodes an NADP(H)-dependent enzyme that interconverts active and inactive glucocorticoids. Although the reaction can run in both directions in vitro, the enzyme predominantly acts as a reductase in vivo, converting cortisone to cortisol and increasing local active-glucocorticoid availability. This directional distinction connects its enzymatic role with regulation of glucocorticoid action.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving HSD11B1 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cutaneous melanoma, and lung adenocarcinoma.
